state.situationOverview: A confirmed wildfire is accelerating eastward toward occupied homes, with smoke exposure, blocked east access, and active medical and evacuation needs. Four hikers reached the south meeting point, while two exposed hikers and two adults—including a wheelchair user and a person with breathing difficulty—still require verified safety and support.

plan.objective: Protect exposed people, sustain assisted evacuation, and preserve safe access while monitoring wildfire spread.
steps: Verify the status and medical condition of exposed people and confirm safe evacuation completion.
Maintain supported evacuation for the adults and coordinate assessment of breathing difficulty and wheelchair needs.
Keep east access controlled and verify continued safety of the south alternative route.
Monitor the east flank, homes, smoke, wind, and unresolved access or medical risks.
Reassess all unknown occupancy, casualty, route, and fire-spread details without inference.
